#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# Archivo generado por create-kvm-vm.sh --comandos
# Ejecuta este archivo cuando quieras crear las VMs manualmente.

# 2026-04-28 22:27:51 ------------------------------------------------
# VM: ceph-admin
# Paso 1: validar imagen base
test -f /var/lib/libvirt/images/ubuntu-22.04-base.qcow2 || { echo '[ERROR] Falta imagen base: /var/lib/libvirt/images/ubuntu-22.04-base.qcow2'; exit 1; }

# Paso 2: generar disco del sistema (si no existe)
if [[ ! -f /var/lib/libvirt/images/ceph-admin.qcow2 ]]; then
  sudo qemu-img create -f qcow2 -b /var/lib/libvirt/images/ubuntu-22.04-base.qcow2 -F qcow2 /var/lib/libvirt/images/ceph-admin.qcow2 20G
fi

package_update: true
packages:
  - chrony
  - openssh-server
  - curl
  - qemu-guest-agent
runcmd:
  - timedatectl set-timezone America/El_Salvador || true
  - sed -i '/^pool /d;/^server /d' /etc/chrony/chrony.conf
  - printf 'server ntp.ues.edu.sv iburst\n' >> /etc/chrony/chrony.conf
  - systemctl enable --now chrony
  - systemctl enable --now ssh
  - systemctl enable --now qemu-guest-agent
  - chmod 700 /home/admin/.ssh
  - chmod 600 /home/admin/.ssh/id_rsa /home/admin/.ssh/authorized_keys
  - chmod 644 /home/admin/.ssh/id_rsa.pub
  - chown -R admin:admin /home/admin/.ssh
  - chmod 700 /root/.ssh
  - chmod 600 /root/.ssh/id_rsa /root/.ssh/authorized_keys
  - chmod 644 /root/.ssh/id_rsa.pub

EOF

# Paso 5: crear cloud-init network-config
cat > /tmp/network-config-ceph-admin.yaml <<'EOF'
version: 2
ethernets:
  enp1s0:
    match:
      macaddress: 52:54:00:cc:dd:10
    set-name: enp1s0
    dhcp4: false
    addresses: [192.168.3.10/24]
    routes:
      - to: default
        via: 192.168.3.1
    nameservers:
      addresses: [8.8.8.8,8.8.4.4]
EOF

# Paso 6: crear VM con virt-install
if ! sudo virsh dominfo ceph-admin >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo virt-install \
    --name ceph-admin \n    --ram 2048 \n    --vcpus 2 \n    --disk path=/var/lib/libvirt/images/ceph-admin.qcow2\,format=qcow2 \n    --network network=net-192-168-3\,model=virtio\,mac=52:54:00:cc:dd:10 \n    --os-variant ubuntu22.04 \n    --cloud-init user-data=/tmp/user-data-ceph-admin.yaml\,network-config=/tmp/network-config-ceph-admin.yaml \n    --noautoconsole \n    --import
else
  echo \[WARN\]\ La\ VM\ ceph-admin\ ya\ existe\ en\ libvirt.\ Se\ omite\ creacion.
fi

# 2026-04-28 22:27:51 ------------------------------------------------
# VM: ceph-mon
# Paso 1: validar imagen base

  sudo qemu-img create -f qcow2 -b /var/lib/libvirt/images/ubuntu-22.04-base.qcow2 -F qcow2 /var/lib/libvirt/images/ceph-mon.qcow2 20G

package_update: true
packages:
  - chrony
  - openssh-server
  - curl
  - qemu-guest-agent
runcmd:
  - timedatectl set-timezone America/El_Salvador || true
  - sed -i '/^pool /d;/^server /d' /etc/chrony/chrony.conf
  - printf 'server ntp.ues.edu.sv iburst\n' >> /etc/chrony/chrony.conf
  - systemctl enable --now chrony
  - systemctl enable --now ssh
  - systemctl enable --now qemu-guest-agent
  - chmod 700 /home/admin/.ssh
  - chmod 600 /home/admin/.ssh/id_rsa /home/admin/.ssh/authorized_keys
  - chmod 644 /home/admin/.ssh/id_rsa.pub
  - chown -R admin:admin /home/admin/.ssh
  - chmod 700 /root/.ssh
  - chmod 600 /root/.ssh/id_rsa /root/.ssh/authorized_keys
  - chmod 644 /root/.ssh/id_rsa.pub

EOF

# Paso 5: crear cloud-init network-config
cat > /tmp/network-config-ceph-mon.yaml <<'EOF'
version: 2
ethernets:
  enp1s0:
    match:
      macaddress: 52:54:00:cc:dd:11
    set-name: enp1s0
    dhcp4: false
    addresses: [192.168.3.11/24]
    routes:
      - to: default
        via: 192.168.3.1
    nameservers:
      addresses: [8.8.8.8,8.8.4.4]
EOF

# Paso 6: crear VM con virt-install
if ! sudo virsh dominfo ceph-mon >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo virt-install \
    --name ceph-mon \n    --ram 2048 \n    --vcpus 2 \n    --disk path=/var/lib/libvirt/images/ceph-mon.qcow2\,format=qcow2 \n    --network network=net-192-168-3\,model=virtio\,mac=52:54:00:cc:dd:11 \n    --os-variant ubuntu22.04 \n    --cloud-init user-data=/tmp/user-data-ceph-mon.yaml\,network-config=/tmp/network-config-ceph-mon.yaml \n    --noautoconsole \n    --import
else
  echo \[WARN\]\ La\ VM\ ceph-mon\ ya\ existe\ en\ libvirt.\ Se\ omite\ creacion.
fi

# 2026-04-28 22:27:51 ------------------------------------------------
# VM: ceph-osd1
# Paso 1: validar imagen base
test -f /var/lib/libvirt/images/ubuntu-22.04-base.qcow2 || { echo '[ERROR] Falta imagen base: /var/lib/libvirt/images/ubuntu-22.04-base.qcow2'; exit 1; }

# Paso 2: generar disco del sistema (si no existe)
if [[ ! -f /var/lib/libvirt/images/ceph-osd1.qcow2 ]]; then
  sudo qemu-img create -f qcow2 -b /var/lib/libvirt/images/ubuntu-22.04-base.qcow2 -F qcow2 /var/lib/libvirt/images/ceph-osd1.qcow2 20G
fi

# Paso 3: generar disco de datos (si no existe)
if [[ ! -f /var/lib/libvirt/images/ceph-osd1-data.qcow2 ]]; then
  sudo qemu-img create -f qcow2 /var/lib/libvirt/images/ceph-osd1-data.qcow2 50G
fi

# Paso 4: crear cloud-init user-data
cat > /tmp/user-data-ceph-osd1.yaml <<'EOF'

    shell: /bin/bash
    lock_passwd: false

      - ssh-rsa  uceda@uceda-ThinkPad-L15-Gen-2a

package_update: true
packages:
  - chrony
  - openssh-server
  - curl
  - qemu-guest-agent
runcmd:
  - timedatectl set-timezone America/El_Salvador || true
  - sed -i '/^pool /d;/^server /d' /etc/chrony/chrony.conf
  - printf 'server ntp.ues.edu.sv iburst\n' >> /etc/chrony/chrony.conf
  - systemctl enable --now chrony
  - systemctl enable --now ssh
  - systemctl enable --now qemu-guest-agent
  - chmod 700 /home/admin/.ssh
  - chmod 600 /home/admin/.ssh/id_rsa /home/admin/.ssh/authorized_keys
  - chmod 644 /home/admin/.ssh/id_rsa.pub
  - chown -R admin:admin /home/admin/.ssh
  - chmod 700 /root/.ssh
  - chmod 600 /root/.ssh/id_rsa /root/.ssh/authorized_keys
  - chmod 644 /root/.ssh/id_rsa.pub

EOF

# Paso 5: crear cloud-init network-config
cat > /tmp/network-config-ceph-osd1.yaml <<'EOF'
version: 2
ethernets:
  enp1s0:
    match:
      macaddress: 52:54:00:cc:dd:12
    set-name: enp1s0
    dhcp4: false
    addresses: [192.168.3.12/24]
    routes:
      - to: default
        via: 192.168.3.1
    nameservers:
      addresses: [8.8.8.8,8.8.4.4]
EOF

# Paso 6: crear VM con virt-install
if ! sudo virsh dominfo ceph-osd1 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo virt-install \
    --name ceph-osd1 \n    --ram 2048 \n    --vcpus 2 \n    --disk path=/var/lib/libvirt/images/ceph-osd1.qcow2\,format=qcow2 \n    --disk path=/var/lib/libvirt/images/ceph-osd1-data.qcow2\,format=qcow2 \n    --network network=net-192-168-3\,model=virtio\,mac=52:54:00:cc:dd:12 \n    --os-variant ubuntu22.04 \n    --cloud-init user-data=/tmp/user-data-ceph-osd1.yaml\,network-config=/tmp/network-config-ceph-osd1.yaml \n    --noautoconsole \n    --import
else
  echo \[WARN\]\ La\ VM\ ceph-osd1\ ya\ existe\ en\ libvirt.\ Se\ omite\ creacion.
fi

# 2026-04-28 22:27:51 ------------------------------------------------
# VM: ceph-osd2
# Paso 1: validar imagen base
test -f /var/lib/libvirt/images/ubuntu-22.04-base.qcow2 || { echo '[ERROR] Falta imagen base: /var/lib/libvirt/images/ubuntu-22.04-base.qcow2'; exit 1; }

# Paso 2: generar disco del sistema (si no existe)
if [[ ! -f /var/lib/libvirt/images/ceph-osd2.qcow2 ]]; then
  sudo qemu-img create -f qcow2 -b /var/lib/libvirt/images/ubuntu-22.04-base.qcow2 -F qcow2 /var/lib/libvirt/images/ceph-osd2.qcow2 20G
fi

# Paso 3: generar disco de datos (si no existe)
if [[ ! -f /var/lib/libvirt/images/ceph-osd2-data.qcow2 ]]; then
  sudo qemu-img create -f qcow2 /var/lib/libvirt/images/ceph-osd2-data.qcow2 50G
fi

# Paso 4: crear cloud-init user-data
cat > /tmp/user-data-ceph-osd2.yaml <<'EOF'

package_update: true
packages:
  - chrony
  - openssh-server
  - curl
  - qemu-guest-agent
runcmd:
  - timedatectl set-timezone America/El_Salvador || true
  - sed -i '/^pool /d;/^server /d' /etc/chrony/chrony.conf
  - printf 'server ntp.ues.edu.sv iburst\n' >> /etc/chrony/chrony.conf
  - systemctl enable --now chrony
  - systemctl enable --now ssh
  - systemctl enable --now qemu-guest-agent
  - chmod 700 /home/admin/.ssh
  - chmod 600 /home/admin/.ssh/id_rsa /home/admin/.ssh/authorized_keys
  - chmod 644 /home/admin/.ssh/id_rsa.pub
  - chown -R admin:admin /home/admin/.ssh
  - chmod 700 /root/.ssh
  - chmod 600 /root/.ssh/id_rsa /root/.ssh/authorized_keys
  - chmod 644 /root/.ssh/id_rsa.pub

EOF

# Paso 5: crear cloud-init network-config
cat > /tmp/network-config-ceph-osd2.yaml <<'EOF'
version: 2
ethernets:
  enp1s0:
    match:
      macaddress: 52:54:00:cc:dd:13
    set-name: enp1s0
    dhcp4: false
    addresses: [192.168.3.13/24]
    routes:
      - to: default
        via: 192.168.3.1
    nameservers:
      addresses: [8.8.8.8,8.8.4.4]
EOF

# Paso 6: crear VM con virt-install
if ! sudo virsh dominfo ceph-osd2 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo virt-install \
    --name ceph-osd2 \n    --ram 2048 \n    --vcpus 2 \n    --disk path=/var/lib/libvirt/images/ceph-osd2.qcow2\,format=qcow2 \n    --disk path=/var/lib/libvirt/images/ceph-osd2-data.qcow2\,format=qcow2 \n    --network network=net-192-168-3\,model=virtio\,mac=52:54:00:cc:dd:13 \n    --os-variant ubuntu22.04 \n    --cloud-init user-data=/tmp/user-data-ceph-osd2.yaml\,network-config=/tmp/network-config-ceph-osd2.yaml \n    --noautoconsole \n    --import
else
  echo \[WARN\]\ La\ VM\ ceph-osd2\ ya\ existe\ en\ libvirt.\ Se\ omite\ creacion.
fi

# 2026-04-28 22:27:51 ------------------------------------------------
# VM: ceph-osd3
# Paso 1: validar imagen base
test -f /var/lib/libvirt/images/ubuntu-22.04-base.qcow2 || { echo '[ERROR] Falta imagen base: /var/lib/libvirt/images/ubuntu-22.04-base.qcow2'; exit 1; }

# Paso 2: generar disco del sistema (si no existe)
if [[ ! -f /var/lib/libvirt/images/ceph-osd3.qcow2 ]]; then
  sudo qemu-img create -f qcow2 -b /var/lib/libvirt/images/ubuntu-22.04-base.qcow2 -F qcow2 /var/lib/libvirt/images/ceph-osd3.qcow2 20G
fi

# Paso 3: generar disco de datos (si no existe)
if [[ ! -f /var/lib/libvirt/images/ceph-osd3-data.qcow2 ]]; then
  sudo qemu-img create -f qcow2 /var/lib/libvirt/images/ceph-osd3-data.qcow2 50G
fi

# Paso 4: crear cloud-init user-data
cat > /tmp/user-data-ceph-osd3.yaml <<'EOF'

  - path: /root/.ssh/id_rsa.pub
    owner: root:root
    permissions: '0644'
    content: |
      ssh-rsa  uceda@uceda-ThinkPad-L15-Gen-2a
  - path: /root/.ssh/authorized_keys
    owner: root:root
    permissions: '0600'
    content: |
      ssh-rsa  uceda@uceda-ThinkPad-L15-Gen-2a
      ssh-rsa  uceda@uceda-ThinkPad-L15-Gen-2a

package_update: true
packages:
  - chrony
  - openssh-server
  - curl
  - qemu-guest-agent
runcmd:
  - timedatectl set-timezone America/El_Salvador || true
  - sed -i '/^pool /d;/^server /d' /etc/chrony/chrony.conf
  - printf 'server ntp.ues.edu.sv iburst\n' >> /etc/chrony/chrony.conf
  - systemctl enable --now chrony
  - systemctl enable --now ssh
  - systemctl enable --now qemu-guest-agent
  - chmod 700 /home/admin/.ssh
  - chmod 600 /home/admin/.ssh/id_rsa /home/admin/.ssh/authorized_keys
  - chmod 644 /home/admin/.ssh/id_rsa.pub
  - chown -R admin:admin /home/admin/.ssh
  - chmod 700 /root/.ssh
  - chmod 600 /root/.ssh/id_rsa /root/.ssh/authorized_keys
  - chmod 644 /root/.ssh/id_rsa.pub

EOF

# Paso 5: crear cloud-init network-config
cat > /tmp/network-config-ceph-osd3.yaml <<'EOF'
version: 2
ethernets:
  enp1s0:
    match:
      macaddress: 52:54:00:cc:dd:14
    set-name: enp1s0
    dhcp4: false
    addresses: [192.168.3.14/24]
    routes:
      - to: default
        via: 192.168.3.1
    nameservers:
      addresses: [8.8.8.8,8.8.4.4]
EOF

# Paso 6: crear VM con virt-install
if ! sudo virsh dominfo ceph-osd3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo virt-install \
    --name ceph-osd3 \n    --ram 2048 \n    --vcpus 2 \n    --disk path=/var/lib/libvirt/images/ceph-osd3.qcow2\,format=qcow2 \n    --disk path=/var/lib/libvirt/images/ceph-osd3-data.qcow2\,format=qcow2 \n    --network network=net-192-168-3\,model=virtio\,mac=52:54:00:cc:dd:14 \n    --os-variant ubuntu22.04 \n    --cloud-init user-data=/tmp/user-data-ceph-osd3.yaml\,network-config=/tmp/network-config-ceph-osd3.yaml \n    --noautoconsole \n    --import
else
  echo \[WARN\]\ La\ VM\ ceph-osd3\ ya\ existe\ en\ libvirt.\ Se\ omite\ creacion.
fi
